integrity: An exact rational Taylor polynomial and an explicit rational bound prove the six-state sign. General reversible positivity is proved algebraically. The claims have not received independent validation or historical priority certification.
limitations: Classical stationary finite-state Markov pure dephasing and ideal time-antisymmetric pulse modulation. No assertion of six-state minimality, inverse characterizations, quantum-bath extension, or practical detection without phase reference.
title: Echo reflection positivity and a six-state nonequilibrium sign inversion
